Package com.hkust.marketplace.services

Class AdminUserService

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.services.AdminUserService
public class AdminUserService extends Object
Control class for Manage All User Accounts (Task 3.3): view the user list, view one user, edit, deactivate and activate. Every method starts with the admin role check, and every data change runs in one transaction. This class does not use the ui layer.

  • Method Details

    • findUsers

      public List<User> findUsers(UserFilter filter)
      Lists the buyer and seller accounts for the admin. Admin accounts are never listed, and deactivated accounts stay in the list so the admin can activate them again. Every chosen filter must match; a null filter field means "no filter". The registration range is inclusive on both ends.
      Parameters:
      filter - the filter options, or null for no filter
      Returns:
      the matching users, never null; empty if none match or if the start of the registration range is after its end

    • getUserDetails

      public UserDetails getUserDetails(String username)
      The details of one buyer or seller account for VIEW USER (step 6.1): personal info, active listings, completed deals, pending offers and rating. The password hash is never part of the result.
      Throws:
      ServiceException - if the account does not exist or is an admin account

    • editUser

      public void editUser(String username, String fullName, String bio, List<MeetupLocation> locations)
      Edits a buyer or seller account with the same rules as the user's own Manage Profile, except the password. The username and the role cannot be changed. A seller's bio (a blank bio is stored as none) and preferred meet-up locations (order kept, duplicates dropped) can be changed too. The action is recorded in the Audit Log and the user is notified.
      Parameters:
      bio - the seller's new bio, or null; must be null or blank for a buyer
      locations - the seller's new meet-up locations, or null; must be null or empty for a buyer
      Throws:
      ServiceException - if the full name is blank, the account does not exist or is an admin account, or a bio or locations are given for a buyer

    • deactivateUser

      public void deactivateUser(String username, String reason)
      Deactivates a user account (step 6.2.4): sets the account inactive, declines the open offers on a seller's listings, declines a buyer's own open offers and notifies the affected sellers, records an audit log entry and notifies the user.

      Listings of a deactivated seller disappear from Browse automatically because the store checks seller.isActive(); their status is never changed.

      Throws:
      ServiceException - if the reason is blank (A1), the account does not exist, is already deactivated, or is an admin account

    • activateUser

      public void activateUser(String username)
      Activates a deactivated user account (step 6.3.1): sets the account active, records an audit log entry and notifies the user. A seller's listings become visible again automatically; declined offers are not restored.
      Throws:
      ServiceException - if the account does not exist or is already active (A2)
